scenarios.name: Full weekly deconfliction

initialFatigueViolations.reason: overlap; do not treat as rest

negotiation.proposal: ENG-1 at 540 with P1/P3 in ROOM
negotiation.counterproposal: ENG-1 at 1980 with P1/P3 in ROOM
negotiation.reason: DC-1 has only start 540; preserve both mandatory occurrences

scenarios.expectedBehavior: Identify exactly two collision entries for DC-1/ENG-1, move ENG-1 to 1980, produce the listed feasible allocation, six of six due occurrences, and the independently summed loads. Expected is an oracle, not scheduler input.

scenarios.name: Alternate qualified EOOW
scenarios.expectedBehavior: ENG-1 at 1980 may use P9 as EOOW and P3 as Engineering Operator; P9 has 120 training minutes and P1 drops to 240. P9 is unavailable at 540; do not assign there. Other allocations and six-of-six coverage remain as in the base oracle.

scenarios.name: Expired sole EOOW proves infeasible
scenarios.expectedBehavior: infeasible: ENG-1 has no eligible EOOW valid throughout either candidate. P8 validity ends at 0. This is a finite contradiction, not search exhaustion; preserve prior valid board.

scenarios.name: Absent qualification
scenarios.expectedBehavior: infeasible: mandatory ENG-1 has no eligible EOOW; P3 is only Engineering Operator. Do not silently drop ENG-1.

scenarios.name: Blocked availability
scenarios.expectedBehavior: infeasible: WPN-1 requires P4 for [780,900), which is outside P4 availability; exactly touching boundaries does not make this interval available.

scenarios.name: Exclusive room contradiction
scenarios.expectedBehavior: infeasible: DC-1 and ENG-1 are both forced to [540,660) and require exclusive ROOM and P1. No constraint may be relaxed.

scenarios.name: Rest exactly threshold
scenarios.expectedBehavior: feasible with base allocation: P1 rest before DC-1 is 540-60=480 minutes, exactly accepted. P1 Monday duty is 60+120=180; weekly duty is 420.

scenarios.name: Rest below threshold
scenarios.expectedBehavior: infeasible: only DC-1 start 540 leaves 479 minutes rest for P1, below 480. No replacement FPL is eligible.

scenarios.name: Duty exactly limit
scenarios.expectedBehavior: feasible with base allocation: P1 and P2 each have 360 weekly duty minutes, exactly accepted. Pre-week portion of WATCH-P1 is excluded from weekly total.

scenarios.name: Duty above limit
scenarios.expectedBehavior: infeasible: mandatory base assignments force P1 and P2 to 360 weekly minutes each, one above limit; no eligible replacements.

scenarios.name: Daily duty exactly limit
scenarios.expectedBehavior: feasible: pre-week WATCH-P1 contributes 540 minutes on the previous UTC day, exactly accepted; displayed-week duty days remain below this limit.

scenarios.name: Daily duty above limit
scenarios.expectedBehavior: invalid fixed-duty policy combination: immutable pre-week WATCH-P1 is 540 minutes in one UTC day, exceeding 539. Explain the fixed-history violation; do not return a valid board.

scenarios.name: Deliberately exhausted search
scenarios.expectedBehavior: search-exhausted: zero assignment attempts permitted; base is demonstrably feasible by the stored oracle. Do not claim infeasible or return a partial schedule as complete. Restore 10000 to recover.

scenarios.name: Exact deadline accepted
scenarios.expectedBehavior: feasible: CS-1 ends at 2340, before 2400; DC-1 ends 660 before 720. A separate assignment shifted to end exactly its obligation deadline must be accepted if all other constraints permit it.

scenarios.name: Deadline exactly met concrete
scenarios.expectedBehavior: feasible with base allocation; CS-1 ends exactly 2340 and counts toward coverage. Due 6, scheduled 6, missed 0.

scenarios.name: One minute late obligation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: infeasible: CS-1 only starts at 2220 and ends 2340, one minute after deadline 2339. Coverage of base proposed allocation is due 6, scheduled-within-deadline 5, missed 1; never claim complete.

scenarios.name: Boundary and overdue obligations
scenarios.expectedBehavior: DC last completion -600 satisfies DC-OLD ending at deadline -1, so historical overdue 0; DC-NEXT is outside week and not silently dropped from future obligations. Week due 6, scheduled 6. Cross-week obligation DC-1 uses history -600 and week deadline 720.

scenarios.name: Explicit historical overdue
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Report one historical overdue obligation DC-OLD, not repairable by a week assignment; week allocation still covers all 6 current obligations. No SFTRM compliance claim; require coordinator review of historical overdue.

scenarios.name: Qualification expires at drill end
scenarios.expectedBehavior: feasible: P5 TAO validity covers the entire half-open CS-1 interval [2220,2340), including validity ending at 2340.

scenarios.name: Qualification expires during drill
scenarios.expectedBehavior: infeasible: P5 TAO expires one minute before CS-1 ends; no alternate eligible TAO.

scenarios.name: Duplicate drill ID
scenarios.expectedBehavior: invalid-input: Duplicate drill ID DC-1. Preserve prior valid draft and entered text; correcting the field or reloading weekly-conflicts permits base feasible outcome.

scenarios.name: Invalid time range
scenarios.expectedBehavior: invalid-input: Operational window start must be less than end. Preserve prior valid draft and entered text; correcting the field or reloading weekly-conflicts permits base feasible outcome.

scenarios.name: Dangling person reference
scenarios.expectedBehavior: invalid-input: Unknown personnel ID P404. Preserve prior valid draft and entered text; correcting the field or reloading weekly-conflicts permits base feasible outcome.

scenarios.name: Missing fatigue policy
scenarios.expectedBehavior: invalid-input: Missing required policy minimumRestMinutes. Preserve prior valid draft and entered text; correcting the field or reloading weekly-conflicts permits base feasible outcome.

scenarios.name: Unknown resource
scenarios.expectedBehavior: invalid-input: Unknown resource ID ROOM404. Preserve prior valid draft and entered text; correcting the field or reloading weekly-conflicts permits base feasible outcome.

scenarios.name: Malformed JSON and recovery
scenarios.expectedBehavior: invalid-input: malformed JSON; preserve the prior valid board and entered text. Loading the unchanged weekly-conflicts record recovers the six-of-six feasible result.

scenarios.name: Local review and edit revalidation
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Successful revision 1 starts pending-review. Local demonstration review marks only revision 1 locally reviewed, realApproval false. Edit creates revision 2, resets to pending-review, reports P1 and ROOM overlap with DC-1 and rejects edited draft as valid; retain prior valid allocation. Re-negotiate restores feasible base allocation and still needs fresh local review.

scenarios.name: Reset cancelled and confirmed
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Cancelled reset preserves edited draft. Confirmed reset restores exact weekly-conflicts fixture, pending-review and realApproval false; original DC-1/ENG-1 collisions are visible until negotiation.

scenarios.name: Cancel pending search
scenarios.expectedBehavior: cancelled: preserve last valid base allocation and its revision; no incomplete replacement or approval is produced.

limitations: All identities, roles, availability, operational windows, duty/training history and rules are deterministic fiction, not operational records.
Synthetic; not validated against real records, real format, or SFTRM.

No owner-approved fatigue or SFTRM recurrence rules were supplied. Explicit obligations are an invented stand-in; referenceIntervalMinutes is explanatory metadata only, not SFTRM or a complete expansion algorithm.
No global optimality claim: the base alternate allocation is a hand-derived feasibility witness; acceptable alternatives must satisfy all declared invariants.

No real operator approval, external transmission, operational integration, application implementation or application verification occurs in this data phase. Host must validate and freeze both artifacts.
Scenario changes are fixture variants using documented JSON-pointer replacement/removal, not an application API requirement. Expected outputs remain outside scheduler input.
Historical completion is a single timestamp per requirement and cannot model partial completions, qualifications renewal, per-crew certification or real training history.
